1.name: Group Pose
1.description: Perform a group pose, repeating the last executed emote or action on loop. Camera position, lighting, and color filter can be all be adjusted in the command settings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Text Command: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>/grouppose<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Key Mapping: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> Available

2.name: Idling Camera
2.description: Enable the idling camera. While active, the idling camera will randomly toggle between nearby PCs and NPCs. Executing the command with a PC or NPC targeted will center the camera on that target. Camera position, lighting, and color filter can be all be adjusted in the command settings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Text Command: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>/idlingcamera<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Key Mapping: <hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> Available
